points.statement: The aim is to balance restoration quality against computational efficiency.
points.quote: designed to bridge the gap between restoration quality and computational efficiency

points.statement: The method splits learned features into separate frequency bands at every level of a hierarchical encoder-decoder.
points.quote: explicitly decomposes feature representations into high- and low-frequency components at each scale of a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture

points.statement: It merges frequency decomposition with spatial operations via Fourier-based skip links.
points.quote: combining spectral decomposition with spatial processing through Fourier-based skip connections

points.statement: The design retains spatial detail while capturing complementary frequency information.
points.quote: captures complementary frequency information without sacrificing spatial detail

points.statement: Features are separated into high and low Fourier components at every scale.
points.quote: decomposes features into high and low Fourier frequency components at each scale

points.statement: Specialized blocks process each band according to its characteristics.
points.quote: processes them through specialized blocks tailored to their characteristics

points.statement: High and low frequencies are separated and processed with distinct specialized blocks.
points.quote: separate and process high and low frequencies using specialized blocks for each
